title: 1995 AHSME Problem 6
statement: The figure shown can be folded into the shape of a cube. In the resulting cube, which of the lettered faces is opposite the face marked \(x?\)

solutions.text: Hold \(A\) as the front face. Folding makes \(x\) the left face and \(B\) the top face. The face \(C,\) attached to the right of \(B,\) then folds to the right face, opposite \(x.\) Thus the correct answer is C.
hints: Hold face \(A\) fixed and fold each neighboring square by \(90^\circ\)
Track the outward normal direction of each face as you move through the net
